rules: Named levels with a natural order (Poor, Lower Middle, Middle, Upper Middle, Rich) are ordinal even without digits.
Place names, coordinates, and geometry are geography, never category. This also applies to the hand-made cases.
A column meant to hold coordinates stays geography when its values are dirty; data quality belongs in warnings.
Names that label the groups being charted (establishments, job titles) are category; identifier is for keys.
provenance: Roles where Sonnet 4.6 and GPT-5.4 mini agreed were accepted (183 of 195 columns); the 12 disagreements were decided by the rules above. vizcsv-45cb123b948dd498 has GPT-5.4 mini's labels only because Sonnet exceeded the 90 s profiling timeout twice on its 19 columns.

rule_overrides_of_agreed_labels.note: Both label models said category for these place-name columns (airport, entry region, municipality, district names); the place-name rule overrides them. registry_location (traffic office names) stays category because the values name organisational units, not places. port and entry_port hold airport names, so they are geography too.
